Translation.description: Select text in an app on your Mac, click the small Translation icon, and read the translation nearby as your AI responds. Choose your language in MacHelper, or edit the tool's JavaScript and prompt to make it your own.
features: Translate selected text across supported Mac apps
Explain a selected word in context, with the full sentence translation below
Read the result as the AI generates it
Edit scripts and prompts with reload on save
Keep settings in one MacHelper app
installSteps: Install and open MacHelper on an Apple Silicon Mac.
Choose Install in MacHelper and review the tool's permissions.
Enable Accessibility for MacHelper to read selected text in other apps.
Select a sentence, click the floating icon, and press Esc to dismiss the translation.

screenshots.caption: Interface preview — translate messages and review polished drafts before applying.

MessageHelper-Upwork.description: Translate client messages and polish English drafts on supported Upwork message and feedback pages. This browser companion connects Chrome or Edge to MacHelper on your Mac. You review changes and send messages yourself.
features: Polish English drafts with a preview
Use MacHelper's shared provider and model
Send messages and feedback only yourself
installSteps: Install and open MacHelper on your Mac.
Download and unzip the browser extension source.
Open chrome://extensions or edge://extensions and enable Developer mode.
Choose Load unpacked and select the extracted MessageHelper-Upwork folder.
Open the extension settings and check the connection to MacHelper. Only you send messages or submit feedback.
